body:
@Web search Can you suggest Toronto marketers with examples of generating messages or leads on a modest Meta budget?

Give feedback

Yes. I found several Toronto/GTA marketers with public Meta case studies that are actually relevant to modest-budget lead generation, rather than just showing large-budget ROAS numbers.

Shortlist
Marketer	Public example	Why it fits a modest budget
Ayra Marketing	GTA bathroom-renovation campaign: 21 leads at $90.64/lead on a $20/day (~$600/month) budget. They used a Meta instant form, narrow GTA targeting and a very specific offer: “Your new bathroom in 7 days — or we pay for every day of delay.” 
Ayra Marketing Agency
	Very strong fit if you're talking about hundreds rather than thousands per month.
Manisoft Media	Toronto campaign reportedly generated 251 new conversations with under $550 in ad spend. Their approach emphasizes conversion-focused messaging and Meta lead generation. 
Manisoft
	Particularly relevant if your goal is messages/conversations rather than traditional forms.
Digital Drew SEM	B2B campaign generated 174 website leads at $9.80 CPL, using only $20/day Instagram + $5/day Facebook. 
Digital Drew
	One of the clearest examples I found of testing Meta with a $25/day budget.
Advorize	GTA real-estate campaign: 162 qualified leads at $6.55 CPL from ~$1,060 ad spend, using location targeting and Meta instant forms. 
Advorize
	Useful example of hyper-local targeting + a relatively small total test budget.
Digilite	Toronto mortgage-broker case study focused on generating real, convertible leads rather than simply increasing social engagement. They also published a 2026 case study showing 175 qualified leads at $37.32 CPL using Meta instant forms. 
Digilite | Markham Web Design Agency
+1
	Worth considering if lead quality matters more than cheap form fills.
Bhuwan Rokaha	Toronto-based independent Meta marketer. Publicly reports a real-estate campaign producing 215 qualified leads in 90 days at $12 CPL, using custom audiences, Meta lead forms and a landing page. 
Bhuwan B Rokaha
	More of a solo/freelance option than a large agency.

For local options, these are also Toronto businesses you could investigate: PPC Guru, 1800Marketing Lead Generation, ORCAFY Marketing Agency, and ZimaPeak Marketing Inc.. Their public positioning includes Meta/Facebook/Instagram lead generation, although I found less compelling small-budget numerical case-study evidence for them than the examples above.

The messaging examples are particularly interesting

The strongest pattern across these cases isn't simply "run Facebook ads." It's making the offer extremely specific:

Bathroom renovations: a concrete outcome + deadline + risk reversal. 
Ayra Marketing Agency

B2B: short, action-oriented creative differentiated by Instagram vs. Facebook audiences. 
Digital Drew

Real estate: hyper-local messaging and qualification questions rather than broad demographic targeting. 
Advorize

Toronto event venue: roughly $300/month on Meta as part of a $600/month combined Google + Meta media budget, producing around 20 corporate-event inquiries/month. 
DiscoverMyBusiness

If your budget is, say, $300–$1,000/month, I'd specifically ask prospective marketers to show you a campaign where the total media spend was in that range, not a $10k/month campaign scaled down in theory.

One caveat: these are agency/marketer-reported case studies, so I'd treat the numbers as claims to verify rather than independently audited results. For a comparison, I'd ask each person for the actual ad spend, number of leads/messages, definition of a "qualified" lead, and ideally lead-to-customer conversion.

If you tell me what you're selling, your approximate monthly Meta budget, and whether you want WhatsApp/Instagram DMs, phone calls, or form leads, I can narrow this to 3–5 Toronto marketers whose existing case studies most closely resemble your situation.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
